content.title: Switch time ranges and refresh portfolio performance context
content.intent: Prove that selecting any supported time-range value keeps exactly one active choice and refreshes the chart range, x-axis labels, and period comparison.
content.technique_notes: Equivalence partitioning over the segmented time-range control values. covering_array requested at strength=2 from the default non-money/auth/data-loss risk gate and degraded to effective_t=1 because only one input varied; enumerated representatives were 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD, 1Y, and ALL. Budget estimate remained within the 8-pair ceiling, so all representatives stayed in scope.
